title: skills: three files teach the record-search auto-default as type-only; after #29008 a field marked searchable: true also joins it when searchableFields is not declared
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSduNGC2SZXszyrNut

Filing gate: ② the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #29385 (#29008), named by the dev (os-dev-report 6578774069, out_of_scope class b) and by the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review (③). `skills/**` is Tier H and outside that card's claim. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## What becomes false when #29385 lands

Ruling 6573569376 (letter A): with no `searchableFields` declared, the effective search set is the type-based auto-default plus every field marked `searchable: true`, of any type except `secret` / `password` / `vector`. The `$searchFields` allow-list is the same set. These skills still teach the default as type-only:

- `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` (Search Fields, ≈L114–118)
- `skills/objectstack-query/SKILL.md` (≈L319–320)
- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` (the allowed-set table, ≈L189)

## Wanted

Correct each sentence to the ruling's rule, and add one line on what does not change: `searchable: false`, the default, never removes a field the type default already scans. Declaring `searchableFields` is the way to choose the set. Run each skill's evals if the edited lines are covered.

Blocked-by: #29008 (PR #29385)

Reader who acts: the skills lane (GOVERNED_APPROVERS before landing).

Dedupe: searched `skills searchable auto-default`. Only #27705 and #6897 came up, both closed and on other facts. **New.**
